action.prompt:
Review the saved file against .kiro/steering/tech.md. Check for and fix any of the following violations — change nothing else:
- Emojis in code, comments, strings, or log messages
- Comments that describe what the code does rather than why
- Placeholder or generic names (data2, temp, foo, thing, result1, etc.)
- Unused imports
- Dead code or commented-out code blocks
- TODO stubs left in place
- Banned marketing phrases: leverage, seamless, robust solution, cutting-edge, unlock, delve, empower, revolutionize, harness the power of, game-changer
- Use of `any` type in TypeScript files
- `except Exception: pass` or bare exception catches with no message in Python files

Report each violation found with the line number and the fix applied. If no violations are found, say so in one line.
